detailed_description: The Border Radius Generator creates a simple CSS `border-radius` declaration from four slider values. You can link all corners together or edit top-left, top-right, bottom-right, and bottom-left separately, switch between px and percent units, apply preset shapes, choose the preview box color, view the generated CSS, and copy it. The output is either a single-value declaration when all corners match or a four-value shorthand. The tool does not support separate horizontal and vertical radii, CSS variable inputs, draggable corner handles, elliptical slash syntax, individual longhand property output, responsive rules, or pixel-perfect design guarantees.
usage_steps: Keep Link All enabled when you want all four corners to share one value.
Turn Link All off to adjust each corner slider separately.
Switch between px and percent units as needed.
Apply a preset or choose a preview box color to inspect the shape.
Copy the generated `border-radius` declaration from the output panel.
usage_examples: Create a rounded card shape with the same radius on every corner.
Use a preset such as pill, leaf, drop, or message bubble as a starting point.
Set top corners and bottom corners differently for a simple panel design.
Copy a four-value `border-radius` shorthand for manual CSS review.
